title: Does anybody recognize this battle system plugin?

posts.author: Thrombular_gaming
posts.body:
I'm having trouble finding out where this battle system came from.
Plays a bit like grandia where everyone's actions are on a timeline in the corner.
Looks a bit like something moghunter would make? But I can't find it anywhere..
The game in the screenshot is felt mansion.
It's website has these names under script credit but Doesn't say who scripted what.
Cyanic, Lecode, Moghunter, Nicke, Zeus81.
I think game was made in VXace, but I could be wrong.
Thanks for the help.

posts.body:
